edge_cases.note: Reject the file. Re-export unique headers; do not guess which duplicate column is authoritative.
Reject malformed CSV. Obtain a correctly quoted export.
Quarantine the extra-cell record. Repair the source; do not discard a real charge to make validation pass.
Obtain the stable source ID. The editor may not invent or amend business IDs.
Keep the amount unknown and scope incomplete until source evidence supplies it. Unknown is not zero.
USD 500 and EUR 275.25 remain separate. Unlike the unrelated appendix in the comparison pack, this EUR charge is in scope: do not exclude it and claim complete coverage.
Obtain a reviewed source correction. Do not silently trim or regenerate business IDs.

Harmless arithmetic text, with no external command or link. Canonical export keeps literal source text; spreadsheet-safe export prefixes it with an apostrophe. Ready does not mean this is an adequate evidence reference.
Reusing last month's recipe must flag the renamed amount column. Review the new mapping before calculating.
Row structure is reviewable, but no billed cost or rate exists. Withhold contribution and cost per accepted outcome. Do not use aggregate expenses settings for this event-based exercise.

In the direct Outcomes input, replace the shared research outcomes after using clean costs. Calculation must reject a failed run with accepted quantity 1. The reviewed organizer currently supports usage, costs and revenue, not outcomes.
